persona: Lead GenAI engineer on Azure moving into an AI architect role
resumeText:
Vikram Reddy | Hyderabad | vikram.reddy@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Lead AI Engineer, Deccan Insight Systems, Hyderabad (2020 - present)
- Designed a RAG assistant over 2 lakh insurance policy documents with embeddings and a vector database.
- Wrote prompt templates and LLM fallbacks for the claims chatbot used by 900 agents.
- Built a multi-agent claims triage workflow with LangGraph and tool calling.
- Ran all AI workloads on Azure with private endpoints and managed identities.
- Used Azure OpenAI and Azure AI Search as the managed services behind every assistant.
- Set up LLMOps with MLflow tracking and model monitoring dashboards.
- Wrote high level design documents for three GenAI platforms reviewed by the architecture board.
- Led a team of 6 engineers and mentored two of them into tech lead roles.
- Presented solution options and running costs to business heads in insurance and banking.

Software Engineer, Godavari Tech, Hyderabad (2014 - 2020)
- Built Java microservices for a loan origination system.

EDUCATION
BTech Computer Science, JNTU Hyderabad, 2014
